report:
Gitea 1.22 detected as virus by windows defender

![image](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/assets/18380374/d0fd8082-3fac-4f3a-979b-fbbbef66595a)
When download gitea 1.22 from dl.gitea.com, I got a warning from windows defender.
1.21.10 is fine.

evidence.quote: That's an issue with defender, they seem to be labeling almost every Go program with `Trojan:Win32/Wacatac.B!ml` See also https://go.dev/doc/faq#virus

confirmation.quote: Closing, as Windows Security no longer flags the binary and false positives can be resolved (much quicker than I thought) by submitting the file to Microsoft ourselves.
confirmation.by: anthonyvdotbe (reporter of sibling issue #30593, which silverwind linked as related); Microsoft cleared the signature with no Gitea change

notes: A: a Windows Defender ML signature (Wacatac) false positive on Go binaries. Nothing changed in Gitea (no linked PR/commit); it cleared on the Microsoft side. Caveats: the body is very short, and '1.21.10 is fine' could be read as a regression hint.

reviews.decidable_why: An AV warning on an official download with no other symptoms is a well-known false-positive pattern for Go binaries.
Title/body clearly describe an antivirus detection on the end user's OS, a well-known Go false positive.
